base_member_text: [L87-L106] (MED/fortran-use-parsing) Whitespace tokenization recognizes only bare USE followed immediately by the module name, missing USE-qualified forms and misparsing USE :: module.
audit_member_text: [L87-L106] (MED/fortran-parsing) Whitespace-token parsing misses valid USE forms such as use::m and use, non_intrinsic :: m and misreads use :: m as a dependency on ::.mod.

adversarial.rationale: In-memory execution of the unchanged script with USE :: m, USE::n and USE, NON_INTRINSIC :: q emits only ::.mod in O:M mode, reproducing both omission and misparsing. The complete parser has no normalization beyond whitespace splitting and lowercase comparisons, and the Makefile caller supplies raw sources without a preprocessing step.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

base_member_text: [L77-L79,L114-L115] (MED/silent-input-failure) Unreadable source files are silently skipped on IOError, allowing an incomplete dependency graph to be emitted successfully.
audit_member_text: [L114-L115] (MED/error-handling) Source-file I/O failures are silently ignored and the script can emit an incomplete dependency graph with a successful exit.

adversarial.rationale: An in-memory unreadable-file case reaches the except IOError: pass and exits successfully with no dependency output; there is no later missing-input check in deps or the main program. The Makefile redirects stdout straight into the dependency file, so its shell command cannot distinguish that incomplete-success result from valid output.

base_member_text: [L86-L113] (MED/transitive-dependencies) Included files are recorded but never scanned, so module USE dependencies and nested includes inside them are absent from the generated build graph.
audit_member_text: [L86-L112] (MED/dependency-generation) Included files are recorded but never parsed, so module uses or further includes inside them cannot contribute transitive build dependencies.

adversarial.rationale: Only files in the command-line args loop are opened; recognized includes are appended as names and are never recursively opened (makedepo.py:77-115). Ordinary make transitivity can help if separate rules already exist, but this script generates no nested-include rule or hidden USE edge, and no caller supplies a universal recursive scanner that neutralizes its standalone omission.
adversarial.verified_by: llm:codex gpt-6-astra skeptic + caller verbatim neutralizer re-check

audit_member_text: [L94-L101] (MED/fortran-parsing) Only module procedure is excluded, so module function and module subroutine declarations are incorrectly registered as providers of function.mod and subroutine.mod.
